style.prompt: Create a beautifully designed vertical 9:16 event story graphic for ROOFTOP JAZZ. Sophisticated vintage jazz-club screenprinted graphic design, warm cream paper background, deep burgundy ink, restricted two-color palette. Large elegant expressive high-contrast serif headline at top reads exactly 'ROOFTOP JAZZ'. Central graphic: bold flat burgundy silhouette of a saxophone with flowing abstract musical curves, a small rooftop skyline and a cream moon, restrained art deco framing and subtle paper grain. Clear expertly typeset information block in lower third with these exact four separate readable lines: '17 October 2027' / '7 PM' / 'Atlas Roof' / 'Free entry'. These four details must be spelled precisely. No other words, no logos, no watermarks. Editorial typography, polished music venue poster, generous negative space, highly readable hierarchy, keep all typography inside generous margins away from top and bottom story interface areas. Flat graphic, not a photograph of a poster.
